items.title: Cruel & Unusual
items.reason: Edgar dies after his wife's death and wakes in a mysterious institution where he is told he murdered her and must repeatedly relive the final day. Each repetition changes his understanding: he first sees himself as an innocent victim, then discovers that Maylon poisoned him, later recognizes that he intentionally strangled her, and eventually escapes the institution's normal loop long enough to experience the day from his family's perspectives. Those new viewpoints reveal the controlling behavior and family conflict that preceded the poisoning, reframing both the crime and Edgar's claimed innocence. The film therefore sustains a time/afterlife-rule mystery with repeated answers and reinterpretations across most of the runtime, though its character-redemption drama, modest production values and some repetition keep it below the profile's top tier.
